source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    horizontal = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] in (7, 9)), None)
    if horizontal is not None:
        first, second = grid[:horizontal], grid[horizontal + 1:]
    else:
        vertical = next((j for j in range(w) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1 and grid[0][j] in (7, 9)), None)
        if vertical is None:
            raise ValueError("divider not found")
        first = [row[:vertical] for row in grid]
        second = [row[vertical + 1:] for row in grid]
    def foreground(part):
        flat = [v for row in part for v in row]
        background = Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[v != background for v in row] for row in part]
    a, b = foreground(first), foreground(second)
    if len(a) != len(b) or any(len(x) != len(y) for x, y in zip(a, b)):
        raise ValueError("halves have different sizes")
    return [[2 if x and y else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
'''
